infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AirRoute needs your location to find nearby routes and check air quality.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: AirRoute needs your location to suggest the cleanest route.
